top.line: Run your own sgit server in your account and region, deployed from CI with the site factory's pattern.
top.para: One image, S3, an access token, OIDC, checks.

in-short.line: Your own server; one image; keys never reach it; from CI; no AWS keys; check, deploy, tear down; package it.

why.line: Sensitive data raises where it lives and who runs the server; your own account and region answers it.
why.para: Ciphertext moves; the trust model does not.

what.line: One open-source Docker image, configured by environment variables, with memory, disk or S3 storage.
what.para: CloudFormation templates for Lambda, Fargate and EC2, in beta.

pipeline.line: Protected environment, OIDC, trust one repo and environment, least privilege, checks, smoke tests, teardown.

steps.line: Region, OIDC provider, deploy role, environment and secrets, image in ECR, check, deploy, point sgit at it.

package.line: A proposed sgit-deploy GitHub Action and a skill for agents.
package.para: Or a request committed to a repository.

prompt.line: A prompt to set it up with your own Claude, one step at a time.

limits.line: Templates in beta; the job is a sketch to prove in my account; keys still matter; other clouds undocumented.

sources.line: The SG/Send deployment guides vault, its repository, the factory's docs and sgit.ai.
